label: <DEL> step of short sequences (+ first p/q early in input)
explanation: Mainly a delimiter unit: about 81% of activation mass is at the <DEL> step (t == L). It fires on about 47% of delimiter steps overall, mostly when the sequence is short (L <= 6). The strongest activations (near max) are at <DEL> after 3-token sequences, often ones starting with i. A secondary component, about 17% of mass, fires at weaker levels on the first occurrence of p (strongest) or q during the original phase, mainly at positions t = 1..4. It is almost never active in the copy phase (1 step), never at t = 0, and almost never on repeated tokens (in_first == 0). Misses are mostly <DEL> steps of longer sequences (L = 7..9) firing at lower levels, plus occasional f/1 inputs. False positives are <DEL> steps of L = 5..6 sequences that do not fire, and early p/q tokens that do not fire.
